Databricks

AI Infrastructure Engineer

Databricks is creating the data and AI platform of the future. We are seeking a world-class AI Infrastructure Engineer to build high-performance distributed training, fine-tuning, and inference platforms on thousands of GPUs.

What you will accomplish:

  • Build resilient, high-throughput distributed model training orchestration using PyTorch, Ray, and Slurm.
  • Architect auto-scaling GPU inference clusters with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and Triton Inference Server on Kubernetes.
  • Optimize CUDA memory allocation, NCCL communication rings, and cluster networking across heterogeneous hardware.

What we are looking for:

  • 4+ years experience building and operating distributed AI systems, GPU orchestration, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Deep proficiency with Python, Go, Kubernetes, Docker, and Linux performance tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM serving engines (vLLM, HuggingFace TGI) and model fine-tuning frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of distributed storage, object stores (S3/GCS), and PostgreSQL.
